answer: The falcon is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the glacier. Written in a numbers heavy, no adjectives register, it stays short. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. The design leans on session-key rotation bound to work, released only after three unrelated confirmations, auditors are drawn from a rotating pool. By the mesa of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up.
